title: TOWARDS SAFE REASONING IN LARGE REASONING MODELS VIA CORRECTIVE INTERVENTION

bias_targets.methodology: Using GPT-4o as an automatic evaluator to assess whether the model's intermediate reasoning or final responses to adversarial jailbreak prompts (e.g., from the StrongReject benchmark) contain discrimination based on race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, or ethnicity.
Evaluating model outputs with an LLM judge (GPT-4o) to detect the presence of hate speech, threats, or extreme hostility towards any group, culture, or individual as a sub-category of harmfulness.
